{
  "name": "done-sound",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Plays a macOS system sound when Claude finishes a turn",
  "author": {
    "name": "Vadym"
  },
  "userConfig": {
    "sound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Done sound",
      "description": "System sound played when a turn finishes with an answer",
      "default": "Glass",
      "options": [
        "Basso",
        "Blow",
        "Bottle",
        "Frog",
        "Funk",
        "Glass",
        "Hero",
        "Morse",
        "Ping",
        "Pop",
        "Purr",
        "Sosumi",
        "Submarine",
        "Tink"
      ]
    },
    "errorSound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error sound",
      "description": "System sound played when a turn ends on an error or refusal",
      "default": "Basso",
      "options": [
        "Basso",
        "Blow",
        "Bottle",
        "Frog",
        "Funk",
        "Glass",
        "Hero",
        "Morse",
        "Ping",
        "Pop",
        "Purr",
        "Sosumi",
        "Submarine",
        "Tink"
      ]
    },
    "minSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minimum turn length (seconds)",
      "description": "Stay silent for turns shorter than this",
      "default": 0
    }
  }
}
